stage1.impression: A calm, well-composed late-sun living room. The light holds together: the sun comes from the left, and window patches and speaker shadows rake across the back wall. The pair reads as a pair at a glance. But it still reads as high-end archviz rather than a photograph. The cabinets sit darker and more olive than their sunlit setting, with little light visibly passing through them. The rug is a flat grey slab across the foreground, the plaster and credenza are CG-clean, and the left third of the wall burns almost to white while the right falls into dull shade.

blocking_9: Sunlight visibly passes through both cabinets: the acrylic glows and throws a readable green-tinted pool on the wall or floor beside each speaker
The cabinets are no darker than their surroundings (cabinet lum_median >= 75 against a shaded wall of about 100) and their colour reads as cool sage, not olive
The heading area of the wall (500-960 x 40-260) is calm enough to set type over, and the wall goes from hot left to shaded right by no more than about 1.5 stops
The foreground floor or rug has real pile and micro-texture and does not read as one flat grey plane
The plaster and credenza show real surface texture (trowel marks, grain variation), not uniform CG surfaces
The horn throats keep detail (crush under 12%)

defects.what: The horn throat crushes to black (22.6% crushed pixels), a dead hole in the hero object
The left cabinet is murky (lum median 48) and olive (blue median 12), darker than everything around it, and it does not glow with the sun
The right cabinet is also dull (lum median 65, blue 31); the woofer cover reads as a flat matte disc
Light through the cabinet throws almost no green onto the wall (r 165 > g 149): the brief's sun through the cabinets barely reads
The upper-left wall runs at 234 and is nearly clipped, while the upper-right wall sits at about 100: a 2.4-stop slide across the heading wall
The rug is a flat, uniform grey slab with a crisp CG edge, cut by the frame. It is the largest dead mass in the image and reads as render
The credenza's veneer is clean and uniform, catalogue-CG; the turntable is small and lost against the busy wall shadow
The heading area is busy with the horn shadow and sun patches (lum range 118)
A dark jamb column and a hard bright curtain edge on the far left pull the eye out of frame
The socket and lead read as a pasted-on flat white plate at this scale (required by the owner; re-routing allowed)

changes.problem: The sun barely reaches the cabinet fronts, so the tinted acrylic does not glow and casts almost no green light, and the product reads darker than its setting.

evidence.measured: left cabinet lum_median 47.6 and right 65.2, against the wall at 119-234; wall at 1205-1275 x 400-480 r 165 / g 149, so no green transmission

changes.expected: Both cabinet fronts take raking sun, the acrylic lights from within, and a green-tinted transmitted pool lands on the wall and floor to the right of each speaker; cabinet medians reach about 75-95

changes.problem: The cabinets render olive instead of the reference cool sage, because there is no cool fill: their blue channel collapses.

evidence.measured: rgb median 44/75/31 (left cabinet 32/56/12); the reference light through 25 mm is #B2C9A2, sage with a real blue component

changes.expected: The shadow sides take a cool skylight fill, the cabinets move from olive toward sage, and the shaded right wall lifts

changes.problem: The upper-left wall nearly clips while the right half sits in dull shade, so the heading wall is unbalanced.

evidence.measured: lum_median 233.9 on the upper left against 101.9 at 1050-1250 x 30-120; x-profile 236 -> 96

changes.expected: The upper-left wall holds tone near 205-215 and the right stays at about 95 or above: under 1.3 stops across the heading

changes.problem: The horn throats crush to black and read as holes.
changes.expected: The phase plug and throat walls show shape inside the tinted horn; the mouth stays deep green

changes.problem: The rug is a flat grey slab that fills the foreground, cut by the frame, with no pile and a CG edge.

evidence.measured: lum_range 76 and rgb 129/121/109: one uniform grey across 950 px; the crop shows no pile and a razor edge

change.from: position [0.0, -1.1], size [2.4, 1.7], tint #A89A86, value 0.5, displace 0.002, pile 0.012, tex_scale 0.35
change.to: position [0.0, -0.75], size [2.6, 1.6], tint #8E8170, value 0.6, displace 0.006, pile 0.018, tex_scale 0.8

changes.expected: The rug sits further back and lower in frame, warmer and darker, with visible pile and a soft edge. More sunlit plank floor shows in the foreground for depth

changes.problem: The plaster is a smooth CG surface; in raking sun a real wall shows trowel texture.

evidence.measured: lum_range 6.1 in a shaded patch under raking light: no micro-texture

changes.expected: The sun patches and the speakers' shadows rake over visible, fine trowel texture; still calm enough for type

changes.problem: The far-left jamb and curtain edge make a hard dark and bright column that pulls the eye out of frame.

evidence.measured: lum_range 123 with crush 0.45%; the left crop shows a black jamb slot beside a near-white sheer

change.to: open 0.1 (the sheer covers the jamb; the light filters through it)

changes.expected: A soft, luminous sheer edge on the left with no black slot, framing the room gently

changes.problem: The credenza's veneer reads uniform, and the turntable is small against the busy horn shadow.

evidence.measured: lum_median 91, r/g/b 122/86/56, a uniform panel; the turntable is lost at about 130 px wide

change.setting: prop 2 credenza and the record player
change.from: credenza lift 0.85, grain_rot 90; record player left of centre
change.to: credenza lift 0.75 with a satin, slightly varied sheen; move the record player 0.15 m right, toward the frame's centre line, clear of the horn's shadow

changes.expected: The credenza reads as oiled walnut; the turntable sits as a clear, quiet centre accent against a cleaner patch of wall

out_of_scope.request: Give the woofer cover visible cloth weave or depth so it does not read as a flat matte disc
out_of_scope.why: It is the speaker's cover material, a fixed part; it can only be helped by light (c1, c2)

out_of_scope.request: A lighter horn tint so the throat shows more detail
out_of_scope.why: The horn's tint is the speaker's fixed colour; the fill light (c4) is the only lever
